description: Look things up in the shared, read-only knowledge base. Start with op read and no path (the root); the root tells you what exists. Then read the child you need; find searches by keyword and/or a single exact tag (both conditions must match when supplied). Errors: NodeMissing (the line lists what exists), PathBad, MemoryMissing (no knowledge base is set up for you: say so).

op.description: read = show a node's text and its children; ls = list its children only; find = search nodes by keyword and/or a single exact tag

path.description: node path like agents/spawn (lowercase segments joined by /); empty or / is the root; read also accepts node#/JSON/Pointer (RFC6901 ~0/~1 escapes), only on .json leaves; ls/find reject #; a link value is a string `node/path#/json/pointer`; follow it with read

query.description: Non-empty keyword for find (case-insensitive); query or tag is required, and both must match when supplied.

max_bytes.description: read: most bytes of node text to show (default 8000)

tag.description: Single exact, case-sensitive tag for find. Read from top-level tags string arrays in JSON leaves or directory _tags.json; malformed tags are ignored. Query or tag is required.
